title: ci: use larger runners
body:
For some yet unknown reasons the performance of the runners is a lot worse than before causing timeouts for most tasks. Use some bigger runner to try to work around.

I added a comment on the cncf ci infra channel, it seems we are not the only one with problems.

What is going on? Why does it try to copy a non existing image tag?
This does not list the tag locally:
```
skopeo list-tags  docker://registry.k8s.io/pause
```

Another reminder that we should not rely on third party images we do not own/control for testing as they can change at any time...

> What is going on? Why does it try to copy a non existing image tag? This does not list the tag locally:
> 
> ```
> skopeo list-tags  docker://registry.k8s.io/pause
> ```

No idea; my best guess is that the tag did exist. Let’s retry…

> Another reminder that we should not rely on third party images we do not own/control for testing as they can change at any time...

… and we should not have integration tests that copy 40 images when 2 would do.
I already rerun once, but sure another try cannot hurt

Ok so it fails consistently with the same error but it passes in skopeo https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2935

I guess the run in container and run in VM use different enough environment which somehow the failure here...
For the record https://github.com/cncf/automation/commit/f1de260ee22eba05f93e0e8d3b1ad74da30b3e1b or related changes on the CNCF side do seem to suggest they downgraded the runner performance.
